attackers_goals: Attackers may use various methods to execute code in the context of a signed process to avoid detection.
description: A signed process connected to an external IP address that, on a global level, it usually doesn't connect to.
investigative_actions: Verify the destination IP address reputation. Check whether the actor process loaded a suspicious DLL before the alert. Check if the actor process was injected before the alert. Verify whether the process execution and connections are legitimate.
name: Globally uncommon IP address connection from a signed process
